hypotheses: Fibonacci and Phi Ratio may improve occupancy prediction
M9 P24 Alpha/Beta/Gamma/Epsilon responses are candidate future predictive features
plan.current_evidence_boundary: The two-window 16-run quantum batch qualifies measurements. It does not evaluate biological prediction or coherence lifetime. The later 152-window classical OXTR test is a separate pilot.
plan.next_test: Prespecify more labelled genomic windows, partition adjacent windows together, freeze all representations and model selection, then compare held-out prediction against ordinary and shuffled controls.
plan.success: Improvement on independent biological test regions with uncertainty and matched baselines; null findings remain reportable.
